```ts
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { BrowserWindow } from 'electron';
import { Channels, type ProactiveBucket } from '@ds/protocol';
import { SIM_DEFAULTS, initialSimState, type SimEvent, type SimState } from '@ds/sim';
import type { ProactiveTemplate } from '@ds/brain';
import { PROACTIVE_NO_REPEAT_MS, PROACTIVE_RESERVATION_STALE_MS, getKv, openDb } from '@ds/memory';
import type { FactRow, FactStore } from '@ds/memory';
import { B04_FIXTURE } from '../../tests/fixtures/proactive/interrupt-during-generation.fixture';
import {
  DEFER_TIMEOUT_REASON, KV_PROACTIVE_MUTED, ProactiveController, pickTemplate,
  type ProactiveBrain, type ProactiveControllerDeps, type ProactiveLedger, type LedgerRow,
} from './proactive-controller';

// ---- fakes -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class FakeLedger implements ProactiveLedger {
  rows = new Map<string, LedgerRow>();
  reserve(r: Omit<LedgerRow, 'generatedAt' | 'displayedAt' | 'answeredAt' | 'outcome' | 'turnId'>): void {
    this.rows.set(r.id, { ...r, generatedAt: null, displayedAt: null, answeredAt: null, outcome: null, turnId: null });
  }
  markGenerated(id: string, at: number): void { this.rows.get(id)!.generatedAt = at; }
  markDisplayed(id: string, at: number, turnId: string | null): void { const r = this.rows.get(id)!; r.displayedAt = at; r.turnId = turnId; r.outcome = 'displayed'; }
  markAnswered(id: string, at: number): void { this.rows.get(id)!.answeredAt = at; }
  setOutcome(id: string, outcome: NonNullable<LedgerRow['outcome']>): void { this.rows.get(id)!.outcome = outcome; }
  displayedToday(localDate: string): number { return [...this.rows.values()].filter((r) => r.localDate === localDate && r.displayedAt !== null).length; }
  unansweredToday(localDate: string): number { return [...this.rows.values()].filter((r) => r.localDate === localDate && r.displayedAt !== null && r.answeredAt === null && r.outcome === 'displayed').length; }
  templateDisplayedSince(templateId: string, sinceWall: number): boolean { return [...this.rows.values()].some((r) => r.templateId === templateId && r.displayedAt !== null && r.displayedAt > sinceWall); }
  displayedTemplateIdsSince(sinceWall: number): string[] { return [...this.rows.values()].filter((r) => r.displayedAt !== null && r.displayedAt > sinceWall).map((r) => r.templateId); }
  /** Mirrors the store: the caller passes NOW; the staleness cut-off is applied in here. */
  liveIntent(nowWall: number): LedgerRow | null {
    const cut = nowWall - SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_RESERVATION_STALE_MS;
    return [...this.rows.values()].filter((r) => r.displayedAt === null && r.outcome === null && r.reservedAt > cut)
      .sort((a, b) => b.reservedAt - a.reservedAt)[0] ?? null;
  }
  voidStale(nowWall: number): number { const cut = nowWall - SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_RESERVATION_STALE_MS; let n = 0; for (const r of this.rows.values()) if (r.displayedAt === null && r.outcome === null && r.reservedAt <= cut) { r.outcome = 'void'; n++; } return n; }
}

class FakeBrain implements ProactiveBrain {
  sent: Array<{ text: string; reservationId: string; templateId: string; bucket: ProactiveBucket }> = [];
  spoken: Array<{ text: string; reservationId: string }> = [];
  refuse = false;
  lease = false;
  cancelCalls = 0;
  shownCbs: Array<(turnId: string, seq: number) => void> = [];
  userTurnCbs: Array<() => void> = [];
  guard: ((turnId: string) => string | null) | null = null;
  nextTurnId = 't-llm-1';
  async sendProactive(text: string, reservationId: string, templateId: string, bucket: ProactiveBucket): Promise<string | null> {
    if (this.refuse) return null;
    this.sent.push({ text, reservationId, templateId, bucket });
    return this.nextTurnId;
  }
  speakProactiveText(text: string, reservationId: string): string | null {
    if (this.refuse) return null;
    this.spoken.push({ text, reservationId });
    return `proactive-${reservationId}`;
  }
  onSentenceShown(cb: (turnId: string, seq: number) => void): () => void { this.shownCbs.push(cb); return () => {}; }
  onUserTurn(cb: () => void): () => void { this.userTurnCbs.push(cb); return () => {}; }
  setProactiveGuard(g: (turnId: string) => string | null): void { this.guard = g; }
  speechLeaseActive(): boolean { return this.lease; }
  cancelProactive(): Promise<void> { this.cancelCalls++; return Promise.resolve(); }
  /** Test helper: the bubble painted seq 0 of `turnId`. */
  paint(turnId: string): void { for (const cb of this.shownCbs) cb(turnId, 0); }
  userTurn(): void { for (const cb of this.userTurnCbs) cb(); }
}

class FakeChat {
  sent: Array<{ channel: string; payload: unknown }> = [];
  readonly webContents = { isDestroyed: () => false, send: (channel: string, payload: unknown) => { this.sent.push({ channel, payload }); } };
  isDestroyed(): boolean { return false; }
  gates(): Array<{ verdict: string; reason: string; displayedToday: number; unansweredToday: number; mutedUntil: number | null }> {
    return this.sent.filter((s) => s.channel === Channels.proactiveGate).map((s) => s.payload as never);
  }
}

const TEMPLATES: readonly ProactiveTemplate[] = [
  { id: 'world_a', bucket: 'world', text: '窗外的云走得好快。', audited: true },
  { id: 'world_b', bucket: 'world', text: '刚才好像听见鸟叫了。', audited: true },
  { id: 'greet_a', bucket: 'greeting', text: '早上好，今天也要加油。', audited: true },
  { id: B04_FIXTURE.templateId, bucket: 'callback', instruction: B04_FIXTURE.instruction, audited: true },
];

// A local 14:00 — phase 'day', so the D4 `asleep` suppression is off.
const WALL0 = new Date(2026, 8, 1, 14, 0, 0).getTime();
const MONO0 = 1_000_000;

let dir: string;
let db: DatabaseSync;
let state: SimState;
let events: SimEvent[];
let ledger: FakeLedger;
let brain: FakeBrain;
let chat: FakeChat;
let mono: number;
let wall: number;
let foregroundCbs: Array<() => void>;
let returnedCbs: Array<() => void>;
let typingFellAtMono: number | null;
let bucket: ProactiveBucket | null;
let factRows: FactRow[];
let countSince: number;
let controller: ProactiveController;

function makeController(over: Partial<ProactiveControllerDeps> = {}): ProactiveController {
  const deps: ProactiveControllerDeps = {
    state: () => state,
    dispatch: (e) => { events.push(e); applyEvent(e); },
    ledger,
    db,
    brain,
    sensor: { onForegroundChanged: (cb) => { foregroundCbs.push(cb); return () => {}; }, get derived() { return { probableTyping: false, typingStreakStartedMono: null, typingFellAtMono, healthy: true }; } },
    onReturned: (cb) => { returnedCbs.push(cb); return () => {}; },
    facts: { list: () => factRows, retrieve: () => factRows.map((r) => r.value) } as unknown as FactStore,
    history: { countSince: () => countSince },
    chat: () => chat as unknown as BrowserWindow,
    chatOpen: () => false,
    personaCap: 2,
    templates: TEMPLATES,
    nowMono: () => mono,
    nowWall: () => wall,
    random: () => 0,
    // The REAL shouldSpeak (Task 9) runs; only the bucket chooser is stubbed.
    gate: { bucketFor: () => bucket },
    ...over,
  };
  return new ProactiveController(deps);
}

/** The slice of Task 9's reducer this test needs: the gate bookkeeping the controller relies on.
 *  `PROACTIVE_UNANSWERED` (Concerns 7) is recorded by `events` only; nothing here reduces it. */
function applyEvent(e: SimEvent | { type: 'PROACTIVE_UNANSWERED'; reservationId: string }): void {
  if (e.type === 'PROACTIVE_RESERVE') state = { ...state, gate: { ...state.gate, intent: { reservationId: e.reservationId, templateId: e.templateId, bucket: e.bucket, reservedMono: mono, deferUntilMono: mono + SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_DEFER_MAX_MS } } };
  if (e.type === 'PROACTIVE_OUTCOME') state = { ...state, gate: { ...state.gate, intent: null, ...(e.outcome === 'displayed' ? { lastDisplayedMono: mono, displayedToday: state.gate.displayedToday + 1 } : {}) } };
  if (e.type === 'PROACTIVE_MUTE') state = { ...state, gate: { ...state.gate, mutedUntilWall: e.untilWall } };
}

    expect(pickTemplate(TEMPLATES, 'world', ledger, WALL0, () => 0)?.id).toBe('world_b');
    ledger.reserve({ id: 'r2', templateId: 'world_b', bucket: 'world', reservedAt: WALL0 - 1_000, localDate: state.localDate });
    ledger.markDisplayed('r2', WALL0 - 1_000, 't-r2');
    expect(pickTemplate(TEMPLATES, 'world', ledger, WALL0, () => 0)).toBeNull();
    // 31 days later world_a is back in the pool.
    expect(pickTemplate(TEMPLATES, 'world', ledger, WALL0 + 31 * 86_400_000, () => 0)?.id).toBe('world_a');
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import type { BrowserWindow } from 'electron';
import { Channels, type ProactiveBucket, type ProactiveVerdict } from '@ds/protocol';
import {
  SIM_DEFAULTS, bucketFor as simBucketFor, shouldSpeak as simShouldSpeak,
  type GateReason, type GateVerdict, type SimEvent, type SimState,
} from '@ds/sim';
import { proactivePrompt, type ProactiveTemplate } from '@ds/brain';
import { FACT_MIN_CONFIDENCE, sanitizeMemoryText, setKv, type FactStore } from '@ds/memory';
import type { ActivitySensor } from './activity-sensor';
import { sendTo } from './ipc';
import { PROACTIVE_TEMPLATES, nearDuplicate } from './proactive-templates';

/** §8.1 kv key, written here and restored by SimService at startup (§3.10.4). */
export const KV_PROACTIVE_MUTED = 'sim_proactive_muted';
/** §3.10.3 (d): the reason carried by a `discarded` gate record after the 120-s window (Concerns 6). */
export const DEFER_TIMEOUT_REASON = 'defer-timeout';

/** One `proactive_log` row (§3.10.6), camel-cased. */
/** Structural mirror of Task 6's `ProactiveLogRow` (`packages/memory/src/proactive-log.ts`, §3.10.6). */
export interface LedgerRow {
  id: string; templateId: string; bucket: ProactiveBucket; reservedAt: number; localDate: string;
  generatedAt: number | null; displayedAt: number | null; answeredAt: number | null;
  outcome: 'displayed' | 'discarded' | 'suppressed' | 'failed' | 'void' | null; turnId: string | null;
}

/**
 * §3.10.6 writers + the three exact counting queries. **Name-for-name and arity-for-arity identical
 * to Task 6's `ProactiveLogStore`** (`packages/memory/src/proactive-log.ts`) so `index.ts` can pass
 * `new ProactiveLogStore(db)` straight in with no adapter — Task 6 is the producer, this interface is
 * the consumer and follows it (self-review fix; Concerns 2).
 */
export interface ProactiveLedger {
  reserve(row: Pick<LedgerRow, 'id' | 'templateId' | 'bucket' | 'reservedAt' | 'localDate'>): void;
  /** Written when the LLM call starts, or when a text template is synthesised. */
  markGenerated(id: string, at: number): void;
  /** seq 0 painted: sets `displayed_at`, `turn_id` and `outcome = 'displayed'` in one statement. */
  markDisplayed(id: string, at: number, turnId: string | null): void;
  markAnswered(id: string, at: number): void;
  setOutcome(id: string, outcome: NonNullable<LedgerRow['outcome']>): void;
  displayedToday(localDate: string): number;
  unansweredToday(localDate: string): number;
  /** `SELECT 1 … WHERE template_id = ?1 AND displayed_at IS NOT NULL AND displayed_at > ?2` */
  templateDisplayedSince(templateId: string, sinceWall: number): boolean;
  displayedTemplateIdsSince(sinceWall: number): string[];
  /** The one fresh in-flight reservation (`displayed_at IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL`, newer than
   *  `nowWall - PROACTIVE_RESERVATION_STALE_MS`), or null. The store subtracts the staleness itself. */
  liveIntent(nowWall: number): LedgerRow | null;
  /** Voids in-flight rows reserved before `nowWall - PROACTIVE_RESERVATION_STALE_MS`; returns the count.
   *  Takes **now**, not the cut-off — the store subtracts it (do not pre-subtract). */
  voidStale(nowWall: number): number;
}

/** The BrainService surface the controller uses (Step 9 implements it). */
export interface ProactiveBrain {
  sendProactive(text: string, reservationId: string, templateId: string, bucket: ProactiveBucket): Promise<string | null>;
  speakProactiveText(text: string, reservationId: string, templateId: string, bucket: ProactiveBucket): string | null;
  onSentenceShown(cb: (turnId: string, seq: number) => void): () => void;
  onUserTurn(cb: () => void): () => void;
  setProactiveGuard(guard: (turnId: string) => GateReason | null): void;
  speechLeaseActive(): boolean;
}

export interface ProactiveTraceRecord {
  t: 'proactive'; verdict: ProactiveVerdict; reason: string; templateId: string; bucket: string;
  reservationId: string; displayedToday: number; unansweredToday: number;
}

export interface ProactiveControllerDeps {
  /** The FULL reducer state (the gate reads `gate.*`, not the broadcast subset) — Concerns 4. */
  state(): SimState;
  dispatch(event: SimEvent): void;
  ledger: ProactiveLedger;
  db: DatabaseSync;
  brain: ProactiveBrain;
  sensor: Pick<ActivitySensor, 'onForegroundChanged' | 'derived'>;
  /** Breakpoint (c): the reducer's `returned` effect — Concerns 4. */
  onReturned(cb: () => void): () => void;
  facts: Pick<FactStore, 'list' | 'retrieve'>;
  history: { countSince(ts: number): number };
  chat(): BrowserWindow | null;
  chatOpen(): boolean;
  /** character.json `sim.proactive.maxPerDay`, already clamped to [0, PROACTIVE_PERSONA_CAP_MAX]. */
  personaCap: number;
  templates?: readonly ProactiveTemplate[];
  nowMono?: () => number;
  nowWall?: () => number;
  random?: () => number;
  trace?(rec: ProactiveTraceRecord): void;
  gate?: { shouldSpeak?: typeof simShouldSpeak; bucketFor?: typeof simBucketFor };
}

interface Intent {
  reservationId: string; template: ProactiveTemplate; bucket: ProactiveBucket;
  reservedMono: number; deferUntilMono: number;
  /** null until generation started; the turn id afterwards. */
  turnId: string | null;
  generating: boolean;
}

const NO_REPEAT_MS = SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_TEMPLATE_NO_REPEAT_MS;

/** §4.8 selection: same bucket, not displayed in 30 days (by id), not a near-duplicate of a recent line. */
export function pickTemplate(
  templates: readonly ProactiveTemplate[], bucket: ProactiveBucket, ledger: ProactiveLedger,
  nowWall: number, random: () => number,
): ProactiveTemplate | null {
  const since = nowWall - NO_REPEAT_MS;
  const recentIds = new Set(ledger.displayedTemplateIdsSince(since));
  const recentTexts = templates.filter((t) => recentIds.has(t.id) && t.text !== undefined).map((t) => t.text as string);
  const pool = templates.filter((t) =>
    t.bucket === bucket
    && !ledger.templateDisplayedSince(t.id, since)
    && (t.text === undefined || !nearDuplicate(t.text, recentTexts)));
  if (pool.length === 0) return null;
  return pool[Math.min(pool.length - 1, Math.floor(random() * pool.length))];
}

const startOfLocalDay = (nowWall: number): number => { const d = new Date(nowWall); d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); return d.getTime(); };

export class ProactiveController {
  private readonly deps: ProactiveControllerDeps;
  private readonly templates: readonly ProactiveTemplate[];
  private readonly nowMono: () => number;
  private readonly nowWall: () => number;
  private readonly random: () => number;
  private readonly shouldSpeak: typeof simShouldSpeak;
  private readonly bucketFor: typeof simBucketFor;
  private intent: Intent | null = null;
  /** A displayed line waiting for its answer (or the 10-min timer). */
  private awaiting: { reservationId: string; timer: NodeJS.Timeout } | null = null;
  private evalTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  private offs: Array<() => void> = [];
  private disposed = false;

  constructor(deps: ProactiveControllerDeps) {
    this.deps = deps;
    this.templates = deps.templates ?? PROACTIVE_TEMPLATES;
    this.nowMono = deps.nowMono ?? (() => Number(process.hrtime.bigint() / 1_000_000n));
    this.nowWall = deps.nowWall ?? Date.now;
    this.random = deps.random ?? Math.random;
    this.shouldSpeak = deps.gate?.shouldSpeak ?? simShouldSpeak;
    this.bucketFor = deps.gate?.bucketFor ?? simBucketFor;
  }

  /** §3.10.3 startup recovery, then the one PROACTIVE_EVAL_INTERVAL_MS timer (§3.11). Called by index.ts right after `sim.start()` (Concerns 5). */
  start(): void {
    const { ledger, brain, sensor } = this.deps;
    const nowWall = this.nowWall();
    const voided = ledger.voidStale(nowWall);   // the store subtracts PROACTIVE_RESERVATION_STALE_MS itself
    if (voided > 0) console.log('[proactive] voided %d stale reservation(s)', voided);
    const row = ledger.liveIntent(nowWall);
    if (row !== null) {
      const template = this.templates.find((t) => t.id === row.templateId);
      if (template === undefined) {
        ledger.setOutcome(row.id, 'void');
      } else {
        const nowMono = this.nowMono();
        const remaining = Math.max(0, SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_DEFER_MAX_MS - (nowWall - row.reservedAt));
        this.intent = { reservationId: row.id, template, bucket: row.bucket as ProactiveBucket, reservedMono: nowMono, deferUntilMono: nowMono + remaining, turnId: row.turnId, generating: false };
        if (this.deps.state().gate.intent === null) {
          this.deps.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_RESERVE', reservationId: row.id, templateId: row.templateId, bucket: row.bucket });
        }
      }
    }
    this.offs.push(sensor.onForegroundChanged(() => this.onBreakpoint()));
    this.offs.push(this.deps.onReturned(() => this.onBreakpoint()));
    this.offs.push(brain.onSentenceShown((turnId, seq) => this.onSentenceShown(turnId, seq)));
    this.offs.push(brain.onUserTurn(() => this.onUserTurn()));
    brain.setProactiveGuard((turnId) => this.preDisplayCheck(turnId));
    this.evalTimer = setInterval(() => this.evaluate(), SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_EVAL_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  /** §3.10.2 + §3.10.3: one gate evaluation. Emits `proactive:gate` on every call (§2.7). */
  evaluate(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    const nowMono = this.nowMono();
    const intent = this.intent;
    if (intent !== null) {
      if (intent.generating || intent.turnId !== null) return;          // waiting for the bubble
      if (nowMono >= intent.deferUntilMono) { this.discard('discarded', DEFER_TIMEOUT_REASON); return; }
      const fell = this.deps.sensor.derived.typingFellAtMono;
      if (fell !== null && fell > intent.reservedMono && nowMono - fell >= SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_TYPING_FALLING_EDGE_MS) {
        this.onBreakpoint();                                            // breakpoint (b)
      }
      return;
    }
    const state = this.deps.state();
    const verdict = this.gate(state, nowMono);
    if (verdict.verdict !== 'eligible') {
      this.emitGate(verdict.verdict, verdict.reason, verdict.nextEligibleAt, '', '', '');
      return;
    }
    const bucket = this.bucketFor(state);
    if (bucket === null) { this.emitGate('eligible', '', null, '', '', ''); return; }   // §3.10.5: not a suppression
    if (bucket === 'callback' && this.callbackCappedToday(state)) { this.emitGate('eligible', '', null, '', '', ''); return; }
    const template = pickTemplate(this.templates, bucket, this.deps.ledger, this.nowWall(), this.random);
    if (template === null) { this.emitGate('eligible', '', null, '', bucket, ''); return; }     // pool exhausted -> silent
    const reservationId = randomUUID();
    this.deps.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_RESERVE', reservationId, templateId: template.id, bucket });
    this.deps.ledger.reserve({ id: reservationId, templateId: template.id, bucket, reservedAt: this.nowWall(), localDate: state.localDate });
    this.intent = { reservationId, template, bucket, reservedMono: nowMono, deferUntilMono: nowMono + SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_DEFER_MAX_MS, turnId: null, generating: false };
    this.emitGate('deferred', '', null, template.id, bucket, reservationId);
  }

  /** §3.10.4: the tray's 别打扰 value. `null` clears. Persisted, dispatched, announced. */
  setMute(untilWall: number | null): void {
    this.deps.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_MUTE', untilWall });
    setKv(this.deps.db, KV_PROACTIVE_MUTED, untilWall === null ? '' : String(untilWall));
    this.emitGate('muted', 'muted', untilWall, '', '', '');
  }

  /**
   * §3.10.3 "immediately BEFORE display, re-check EVERY layer-4 suppression": BrainService calls this
   * before relaying seq 0 of a proactive LLM turn. A reason means "do not display, cancel the turn".
   */
  preDisplayCheck(turnId: string): GateReason | null {
    const intent = this.intent;
    if (intent === null || intent.turnId !== turnId) return null;
    const verdict = this.gate(this.deps.state(), this.nowMono());
    if (verdict.verdict === 'eligible') return null;
    this.discard('suppressed', verdict.reason);
    return verdict.reason;
  }

  /** §3.11: flushes the in-flight row as void, stops the timer, drops every subscription. */
  async dispose(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    if (this.evalTimer) clearInterval(this.evalTimer);
    this.evalTimer = null;
    if (this.awaiting) clearTimeout(this.awaiting.timer);
    this.awaiting = null;
    for (const off of this.offs) off();
    this.offs = [];
    if (this.intent !== null) {
      this.deps.ledger.setOutcome(this.intent.reservationId, 'void');
      this.intent = null;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  private gate(state: SimState, nowMono: number): GateVerdict {
    return this.shouldSpeak({
      state, nowMono, nowWall: this.nowWall(), personaCap: this.deps.personaCap,
      turnActive: this.deps.brain.speechLeaseActive(), chatOpen: this.deps.chatOpen(), roll: this.random(),
    });
  }

  /**
   * R3-25 / R3-29: at most ONE LLM-generated (callback) line per local day. Counted on DISPLAYED rows
   * whose template id belongs to the callback bucket and whose displayed_at is inside today
   * (Concerns 14: `bucketFor(state)` cannot see the ledger, so the cap is enforced here). The test
   * fixture's `cb_x` id is not in TEMPLATES, so ids with the `cb_` prefix count as callback too.
   */
  private callbackCappedToday(state: SimState): boolean {
    if (this.deps.ledger.displayedToday(state.localDate) === 0) return false;
    const callbackIds = new Set(this.templates.filter((t) => t.bucket === 'callback').map((t) => t.id));
    return this.deps.ledger.displayedTemplateIdsSince(startOfLocalDay(this.nowWall()) - 1)
      .some((id) => callbackIds.has(id) || id.startsWith('cb_'));
  }

  /** The §3.10.5 callback facts: newest non-tombstoned rows at confidence >= 0.6, sanitised, <= 5. */
  private callbackFacts(): string[] {
    return this.deps.facts.list()
      .filter((r) => !r.tombstone && r.confidence >= FACT_MIN_CONFIDENCE)
      .slice(0, 5)
      .map((r) => sanitizeMemoryText(r.value));
  }

  /** §3.10.3 "on breakpoint": re-check, then GENERATE — never before. */
  private onBreakpoint(): void {
    const intent = this.intent;
    if (this.disposed || intent === null || intent.generating || intent.turnId !== null) return;
    const verdict = this.gate(this.deps.state(), this.nowMono());
    if (verdict.verdict !== 'eligible') { this.discard('suppressed', verdict.reason); return; }
    const { template, bucket, reservationId } = intent;
    if (template.text !== undefined) {
      // Zero-token path (§3.10.7): synthesised like first-mes; "displayed" still waits for seq 0.
      const turnId = this.deps.brain.speakProactiveText(template.text, reservationId, template.id, bucket);
      if (turnId === null) { this.discard('failed', ''); return; }
      this.deps.ledger.markGenerated(reservationId, this.nowWall());
      intent.turnId = turnId;
      return;
    }
    if (bucket !== 'callback' || template.instruction === undefined) { this.discard('failed', ''); return; }   // R3-29
    intent.generating = true;
    const text = proactivePrompt(template, this.callbackFacts());
    void this.deps.brain.sendProactive(text, reservationId, template.id, bucket).then((turnId) => {
      if (this.disposed || this.intent !== intent) return;
      intent.generating = false;
      if (turnId === null) { this.discard('failed', ''); return; }
      this.deps.ledger.markGenerated(reservationId, this.nowWall());
      intent.turnId = turnId;
      // The pre-display re-check runs from BrainService through preDisplayCheck() at seq 0.
    });
  }

  /** §3.10.3 "displayed = the band painted seq 0". Charges the caps, arms the unanswered timer. */
  private onSentenceShown(turnId: string, seq: number): void {
    const intent = this.intent;
    if (intent === null || intent.turnId !== turnId || seq !== 0) return;
    const { reservationId, template, bucket } = intent;
    this.intent = null;
    this.deps.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_OUTCOME', reservationId, outcome: 'displayed' });
    this.deps.ledger.markDisplayed(reservationId, this.nowWall(), turnId);   // turn_id lands with the display row
    this.emitGate('displayed', '', null, template.id, bucket, reservationId);
    if (this.awaiting) clearTimeout(this.awaiting.timer);
    this.awaiting = {
      reservationId,
      timer: setTimeout(() => this.onUnanswered(reservationId), SIM_DEFAULTS.PROACTIVE_UNANSWERED_AFTER_MS),
    };
  }

  private onUserTurn(): void {
    const a = this.awaiting;
    if (a === null) return;
    clearTimeout(a.timer);
    this.awaiting = null;
    this.deps.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_ANSWERED', reservationId: a.reservationId });
    this.deps.ledger.markAnswered(a.reservationId, this.nowWall());
  }

  private onUnanswered(reservationId: string): void {
    if (this.disposed || this.awaiting?.reservationId !== reservationId) return;
    this.awaiting = null;
    // Concerns 7: the full-jitter draw happens in the reducer (seeded rng) on this event.
    this.deps.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_UNANSWERED', reservationId } as SimEvent);
  }

  private discard(outcome: 'discarded' | 'suppressed' | 'failed', reason: string): void {
    const intent = this.intent;
    if (intent === null) return;
    this.intent = null;
    this.deps.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_OUTCOME', reservationId: intent.reservationId, outcome });
    this.deps.ledger.setOutcome(intent.reservationId, outcome);
    this.emitGate('discarded', reason, null, intent.template.id, intent.bucket, intent.reservationId);
  }

  private emitGate(verdict: ProactiveVerdict, reason: string, nextEligibleAt: number | null, templateId: string, bucket: string, reservationId: string): void {
    const g = this.deps.state().gate;
    const payload = {
      verdict, reason,
      displayedToday: g.displayedToday, unansweredToday: g.unansweredToday,
      nextEligibleAt: nextEligibleAt === null ? null : Math.max(0, Math.round(nextEligibleAt)),
      mutedUntil: g.mutedUntilWall,
    };
    sendTo(this.deps.chat(), Channels.proactiveGate, payload);
    this.deps.trace?.({ t: 'proactive', verdict, reason, templateId, bucket, reservationId, displayedToday: g.displayedToday, unansweredToday: g.unansweredToday });
  }
}
```

> Reviewer note on `callbackCappedToday`: the two helpers above are deliberately conservative (a callback that displayed today ⇒ silent). If Task 9's `bucketFor` already enforces "1/day" for `callback` from state, the controller's check is redundant but harmless (R3-25 says the cap is the budget; double-enforcing cannot widen it).

```ts
/** §6.6's first message uses a turnId no TurnRunner ever issues; its playback echoes are dropped. */
const FIRST_MES_TURN_ID = 'first-mes';
/** §9.1: the mode acknowledgement's synthetic turn id, same family as 'first-mes'. */
export const MODE_ACK_TURN_ID = 'mode-ack';
/** §8.9: the 记住这个 / 忘掉这个 acknowledgement's synthetic turn id (Concerns 8). */
export const MEMORY_ACK_TURN_ID = 'memory-ack';
/** §3.10.7: a zero-token proactive line's synthetic turn id is `proactive-<reservationId>` (Concerns 8). */
export const PROACTIVE_TEXT_TURN_PREFIX = 'proactive-';
/** §4.10: "the canned answer names which one was forgotten" — `${fact}` is the tombstoned value, <= 24 graphemes. */
export const FORGET_TEMPLATE = '忘了，「${fact}」不再记得了。';
export const forgetLine = (fact: string): string => FORGET_TEMPLATE.replace('${fact}', fact);
export const NO_MEMORY_LINE = '好像没有对应的记忆。';
/** §8.9: `key = pin_${fnv1a(value)}` — 32-bit FNV-1a, lowercase hex. */
export function fnv1a(s: string): string {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (const ch of s) {
    for (const b of new TextEncoder().encode(ch)) { h ^= b; h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; }
  }
  return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}
const isSyntheticTurn = (turnId: string): boolean =>
  turnId === FIRST_MES_TURN_ID || turnId === MODE_ACK_TURN_ID || turnId === MEMORY_ACK_TURN_ID || turnId.startsWith(PROACTIVE_TEXT_TURN_PREFIX);
```

```ts
      // §9.1 interception order: mode command -> memory command -> conversation. Neither command
      // reaches DeepSeek, history, or the runner (R3-12, §8.9).

        this.speakSynthetic(MODE_ACK_TURN_ID, this.pickLine(lines), 'happy');
        return { ok: true as const, turnId: MODE_ACK_TURN_ID };
      }
      const mem = matchMemoryCommand(text);
      if (mem !== null) {
        this.speakSynthetic(MEMORY_ACK_TURN_ID, this.runMemoryCommand(mem), 'happy');
        return { ok: true as const, turnId: MEMORY_ACK_TURN_ID };

      if (!this.runner) {

        return { ok: false as const, code: 'no-key' as const, message: ERROR_HINTS['no-key'].text };

        if (superseded !== null) this.interruptedTurns.add(superseded);

        for (const cb of [...this.userTurnCbs]) cb();          // ProactiveController: PROACTIVE_ANSWERED

        // unexpected one. The composer restores its text on `{ok:false}` (§6.2 rule 6); a bare
        // invoke rejection would leave the user's sentence lost.
        const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
```

```ts
  private pickLine(lines: readonly string[]): string {
    return lines[Math.min(lines.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length))] ?? '';
  }

  /** The previous USER message (newest first), or null. */
  private previousUserMessage(): { id: number; content: string } | null {
    const row = this.deps.store.list({ limit: 20 }).find((r) => r.role === 'user');
    return row === undefined ? null : { id: row.id, content: row.content };
  }

  /** §8.9: X4's two commands. Returns the line to speak. */
  private runMemoryCommand(kind: 'remember' | 'forget'): string {
    const { facts, bundle } = this.deps;
    const prev = this.previousUserMessage();
    if (kind === 'remember') {
      if (prev === null) return NO_MEMORY_LINE;
      const value = sanitizeMemoryText(prev.content);
      if (value === '') return NO_MEMORY_LINE;
      facts.pin(`pin_${fnv1a(value)}`, value, prev.id);
      return this.pickLine(bundle.cannedLines.remember);
    }
    if (prev === null) return NO_MEMORY_LINE;
    const top = facts.retrieve(prev.content, Date.now())[0];
    if (top === undefined) return NO_MEMORY_LINE;
    // Concerns 10: retrieve() returns sanitised VALUES, tombstone() needs the id — matched through list().
    const row = facts.list().find((r) => !r.tombstone && sanitizeMemoryText(r.value) === top);
    if (row === undefined) return NO_MEMORY_LINE;
    facts.tombstone(row.id);
    return forgetLine(sanitizeMemoryText(row.value, 24));
  }

  /**
   * §6.6 / §9.1 / §3.10.7: one synthetic turn — `brain:sentence` + `brain:turnDone`, NO `brain:state`
   * (the trailing idle would cancel the reveal at grapheme 0; see maybeFirstMessage's note).
   */
  private speakSynthetic(turnId: string, text: string, emotion: SentenceEvent['emotion']): void {
    const { pet, bubble, chat } = this.deps;
    const sentence: SentenceEvent = { turnId, seq: 0, text, emotion };
    const done = { turnId, usage: null, ttftMs: null, totalMs: 0, complianceMiss: false, regenerated: false, lint: { violations: [], severity: 'none' as const } };
    this.cancelBubbleHide();
    this.showBubble();
    for (const win of [pet, bubble]) sendTo(win, Channels.brainSentence, sentence);
    for (const win of [pet, bubble, chat]) sendTo(win, Channels.brainTurnDone, done);
  }
```

Add to `BrainService` (public, after `replaceKey`):

```ts
  /**
   * §3.10.3: the ONE entry point for a generated proactive line. Refuses — null, never throws — when
   * runner === null (no key), runner.state !== 'idle' (R3-3: never interrupts a user reply), mode is
   * 'plain' (R3-12), or reservationId is not the live intent. Sends `proactive:turn` FIRST (§2.7).
   */
  async sendProactive(text: string, reservationId: string, templateId: string, bucket: ProactiveBucket): Promise<string | null> {
    if (this.disposed || !this.runner || this.runner.state !== 'idle' || this.mode === 'plain') return null;
    if (this.liveReservation !== null && this.liveReservation !== reservationId) return null;
    if (this.proactiveTextPending !== null) return null;
    this.liveReservation = reservationId;
    // The turn id is known before send() resolves only through the runner's idFactory, which is
    // Phase 2's; so proactive:turn is sent with a PROVISIONAL id and re-sent with the real one is NOT
    // allowed (§2.7: exactly once). Instead the id is minted here and handed to the runner (Concerns 11).
    const turnId = globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
    const payload = { turnId, reservationId, templateId, bucket };
    sendTo(this.deps.bubble, Channels.proactiveTurn, payload);
    sendTo(this.deps.chat, Channels.proactiveTurn, payload);
    this.proactiveTurns.add(turnId);
    const issued = await this.runner.send(text, 'proactive', turnId);
    if (issued !== turnId) { this.proactiveTurns.delete(turnId); this.proactiveTurns.add(issued); }
    return issued;
  }

  /**
   * §3.10.7 zero-token path: a `text` template spoken exactly like first-mes — proactive:turn, then
   * brain:sentence + brain:turnDone, no brain:state; the history row (`kind: 'proactive'`) is written on
   * the bubble's playback:turnDone. Refused under a live runner turn, in plain mode, or while another
   * synthetic proactive line is unpainted.
   */
  speakProactiveText(text: string, reservationId: string, templateId: string, bucket: ProactiveBucket): string | null {
    if (this.disposed || this.mode === 'plain' || this.proactiveTextPending !== null) return null;
    if (this.runner !== null && this.runner.state !== 'idle') return null;
    if (this.liveReservation !== null && this.liveReservation !== reservationId) return null;
    const turnId = `${PROACTIVE_TEXT_TURN_PREFIX}${reservationId}`;
    this.liveReservation = reservationId;
    const payload = { turnId, reservationId, templateId, bucket };
    sendTo(this.deps.bubble, Channels.proactiveTurn, payload);
    sendTo(this.deps.chat, Channels.proactiveTurn, payload);
    this.proactiveTextPending = { turnId, text };
    this.speakSynthetic(turnId, text, 'happy');
    return turnId;
  }

  onSentenceShown(cb: (turnId: string, seq: number) => void): () => void {
    this.sentenceShownCbs.add(cb);
    return () => { this.sentenceShownCbs.delete(cb); };
  }

  onUserTurn(cb: () => void): () => void {
    this.userTurnCbs.add(cb);
    return () => { this.userTurnCbs.delete(cb); };
  }

  /** §3.10.3: consulted before seq 0 of a proactive LLM turn is relayed. */
  setProactiveGuard(guard: (turnId: string) => GateReason | null): void {
    this.proactiveGuard = guard;
  }

  /** §11.3: a TurnRunner turn is not idle, or a synthetic line (greeting / proactive text) is unpainted. */
  speechLeaseActive(): boolean {
    return (this.runner !== null && this.runner.state !== 'idle') || this.firstMesPending || this.proactiveTextPending !== null;
  }

  /** §11.3 / R3-17: retire the live turn as interrupted (history `[中断]`); awaited before the bubble is destroyed. */
  async retireSpeech(): Promise<void> {
    const runner = this.runner;
    if (runner === null) return;
    const turnId = runner.turnId;
    if (turnId !== null) this.interruptedTurns.add(turnId);
    const work = runner.cancel();
    if (turnId !== null && runner.state !== 'idle') runner.turnShown(turnId);   // CX-1, as bubbleCrashed
    await work;
  }
```

```ts
describe('§3.11: composeDrain — the four-await quit sequence', () => {
  const step = (calls: string[], name: string, opts: { reject?: boolean; gate?: Promise<void> } = {}) => ({
    name,
    dispose: async () => {
      calls.push(`begin:${name}`);
      if (opts.gate) await opts.gate;
      if (opts.reject) throw new Error(`${name} failed`);
      calls.push(`end:${name}`);
    },
  });

  it('awaits every step in order: brain → proactive → sim → extractor', async () => {
    const calls: string[] = [];
    let release: () => void = () => {};
    const gate = new Promise<void>((r) => { release = r; });
    const drain = composeDrain(
      [step(calls, 'brain', { gate }), step(calls, 'proactive'), step(calls, 'sim'), step(calls, 'extractor')],
      () => {},
    );
    const done = drain();
    await Promise.resolve();
    expect(calls).toEqual(['begin:brain']); // proactive has not started: the awaits are serial
    release();
    await done;
    expect(calls).toEqual([
```

```ts
export interface QuitDeps {
  /** Synchronous teardown that must happen at once (hotkeys, screen listeners, save position). */
  teardownSync(): void;
  /**
   * The barrier. Phase 2 passed `brain.dispose()` alone; Phase 3 (§3.11) passes
   * `composeDrain([brain, proactive, sim, extractor])` — four serialised awaits, each isolated.
   */
  drain(): Promise<void>;
  /** Everything that must follow the drain and precede the db: destroy the windows, the tray. */
  teardownAfterDrain(): void;
  closeDb(): void;
  /** `app.quit()` — raises `before-quit` again, which the handler now lets through. */
  quit(): void;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  log?: (line: string) => void;
}

export type QuitPhase = 'idle' | 'draining' | 'done';

/**
 * §3.11: sized for ONE await in Phase 2; Phase 3 puts four inside `drain()`. Re-derived from the
 * measured p95 of the composed drain (Task 15 Step 11) and recorded as an Amendment if it moves.
 */
export const DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 3000;

/** One member of the composed drain; `name` is what the `[quit]` log lines carry. */
export interface DrainStep {
  name: string;
  dispose(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * §3.11's exact order, as ONE `drain()`: `brain → proactive → sim → extractor`, awaited serially.
 * Every step is isolated — a rejecting `brain.dispose()` must not skip `sim.dispose()`, or the kv
 * snapshot (§3.12) is lost to an unrelated error. Each settle time is logged so Step 11 can measure
 * the whole drain against `DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS`.
 */
export function composeDrain(
  steps: readonly DrainStep[],
  log: (line: string) => void = (line) => console.log(line),
  now: () => number = Date.now,
): () => Promise<void> {
  return async () => {
    for (const s of steps) {
      const t0 = now();
      try {
        await s.dispose();
        log(`[quit] drain ${s.name} settled in ${now() - t0} ms`);
      } catch (err) {
        log(`[quit] drain ${s.name} failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`);
      }
    }
  };
}
```

```ts
// userData must be %APPDATA%\ds, not %APPDATA%\@ds\desktop (the package name). This is also what

app.setName('ds');
registerAppScheme(); // must happen before the app is ready

const PIDS_REFRESH_MS = 2000;

const KV_WORK_MODE = 'ui_work_mode';
const KV_SFX_MUTED = 'ui_sfx_muted';
const KV_TURNS_SINCE_EXTRACT = 'mem_turns_since_extract';

let pet: BrowserWindow | null = null;
let bubbleWin: LazyWindow<BrowserWindow> | null = null;
let chatWin: LazyWindow<BrowserWindow> | null = null;
let keyWin: LazyWindow<BrowserWindow> | null = null;
let bubbleLifecycle: BubbleLifecycle<BrowserWindow> | null = null;
let tray: Tray | null = null; // held so the icon is not garbage-collected
let cursorPolling: CursorPolling | null = null;
let foreground: ForegroundWatch | null = null;
let sensor: ActivitySensor | null = null;
let brain: BrainService | null = null;
let sim: SimService | null = null;
let motion: WindowMotionController | null = null;
let proactive: ProactiveController | null = null;
let extractor: FactExtractor | null = null;
let modeStore: ModeStore | null = null;
let db: DatabaseSync | null = null;
let history: HistoryStore | null = null;
let pidsTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
/** CX-3: the visibility-aware gate every key-window show goes through; null until ready. */
let keyRequest: KeyRequest | null = null;
/** GC2-2: holds a `second-instance` that fires before `whenReady` built `requestChat`. */
const chatRequest = createLateBoundChatRequest();
/** §12.2: a no-op unless DS_TRACE is set, so production pays nothing. Task 7's factory reads
 *  DS_TRACE and DS_TRACE_RESOURCE itself — do not call the constructor with a bare path. */
const trace = TraceWriter.fromEnv();

/**
 * §5.9: main ORs two INDEPENDENT reasons to force the pet window click-through — the Phase 1
 * `avatar:hover` predicate (pointer not on an opaque pixel) and the work-mode fade
 * (`arb:passthrough {faded:true}`). R3-5 adds one suspension: during a user drag hover switching is
 * suspended so `avatar:hover` cannot flip click-through under a live drag; the autonomous phases
 * (fling/walk/settling) force click-through outright through `WindowMotionDeps.setClickThrough`.
 */
const petClickThrough = {
  hoverInside: false,
  faded: false,
  suspended: false,
  apply(): void {
    if (!pet || this.suspended) return;
    setClickThrough(pet, !this.hoverInside || this.faded);
  },
};

/**
 * The single owner of the pet window's visibility (Phase 2 comment kept in full meaning: four
 * OR-ed reasons; `locked` and `suspended` tracked separately because real Windows lock+sleep is
 * lock-screen -> suspend -> resume -> (lock screen still showing) -> unlock-screen).
 *
 * Phase 3 (§7.7): the hide arm cancels a live motion episode — a pet that vanishes mid-fling must
 * not land off-screen while invisible. §11.2: the bubble and chat are reached through `peek()`, so
 * a verdict can never resurrect a destroyed window. §12.2: every verdict is a `visibility` record.
 */
const visibility = createVisibilityController({
  window: () => pet,
  send: (verdict) => {
    if (pet) sendToPet(pet, Channels.shellVisibility, verdict);
    const b = bubbleWin?.peek() ?? null;
    if (b) {
      sendTo(b, Channels.shellVisibility, verdict);
      bubbleVis.apply();
    }
    const c = chatWin?.peek() ?? null;
    if (verdict.hidden && c) closeChat(c);
    if (verdict.hidden) motion?.cancel();
    trace.write('visibility', { hidden: verdict.hidden, reason: verdict.reason });
    // CX-3: a key prompt queued behind a lock screen / fullscreen app is shown once the verdict clears.
    keyRequest?.onVerdict();
  },
  setCursorPaused: (paused) => cursorPolling?.setPaused(paused),
  // Both Phase 1 options are load-bearing (see visibility-state.ts): force click-through on every
  // hide, and re-read the pointer the moment she is shown again.
  setClickThrough: (ignore) => { if (pet) setClickThrough(pet, ignore); },
  recheckCursor: () => cursorPolling?.recheck(),
});

/**
 * The bubble window's only show path (`BrainService.setBubbleVisible` is `showBubble` below, which
 * recreates before it reconciles). Loses to VisibilityState by construction (§5.4 rule 5).
 * §11.3: every hide also feeds the grace timer; `onHidden` runs even for an already-hidden window
 * (M-8 / G2-5) and that is exactly what re-arms a grace whose window came down under a verdict.
 */
const bubbleVis = createBubbleVisibility({
  window: () => bubbleWin?.peek() ?? null,
  shellHidden: () => visibility.verdict.hidden,
  onHidden: () => {
    brain?.bubbleHidden();
    bubbleLifecycle?.onHidden();
  },
  onShown: () => {
    const b = bubbleWin?.peek();
    if (b) sendTo(b, Channels.shellVisibility, visibility.verdict);
  },
});

/** §11.3 "on anything that needs the bubble": bump the grace generation, recreate, then reconcile. */
const showBubble = (on: boolean): void => {
  if (on) {
    bubbleLifecycle?.onNeeded();
    bubbleWin?.get();
  }
  bubbleVis.set(on);
};

if (!app.requestSingleInstanceLock()) {
  app.quit();
} else {
  // GC2-2 / A-31: a second launch is the user asking for her — the same request as the tray item
  // and the hotkey, through the same gate. Before wiring the request is held and replayed once.
  app.on('second-instance', () => chatRequest.request('second-instance', true));

  app.whenReady().then(() => {
    serveRenderer(join(__dirname, '../renderer'));

    // spec §8 / contracts.md §4.1: she never runs without persistence.
    const dbPath = join(app.getPath('userData'), 'ds.sqlite');
    try {

    } catch (err) {
      fatal(err instanceof MemoryOpenError ? err.message : `无法打开数据库：${dbPath}\n${String(err)}`);
      return;
    }
    const database = db;

    const bundlePath = app.isPackaged
      ? join(process.resourcesPath, 'characters', 'haru', 'character.json')
      : join(__dirname, '../../../../characters/haru/character.json');
    let bundle: CharacterBundle;
    try {
      bundle = parseCharacterBundle(JSON.parse(readFileSync(bundlePath, 'utf8')));
    } catch (err) {
      fatal(`角色卡读不了：${bundlePath}\n${String(err)}`);
      return;
    }

    // G2-6 / CX-7: ONE startup failure policy for all four renderer documents.
    const startupCleanup: StartupCleanup = {
      destroyWindow: () => {
        for (const lazy of [bubbleWin, chatWin, keyWin]) lazy?.destroy();
        if (pet && !pet.isDestroyed()) pet.destroy();
        pet = null;
      },
      stopCursor: () => cursorPolling?.stop(),
      stopForeground: () => foreground?.stop(),
      destroyTray: () => {
        tray?.destroy();
        tray = null;
      },
      quit: () => app.quit(),
    };
    const onLoadFailure = (surface: string) => (err: unknown): void => {
      console.error('[%s] renderer document failed to load', surface);
      handleLoadFailure(err, startupCleanup);
    };

    const petWin = createPetWindow({
      onReadyToShow: () => visibility.apply(),
      onLoadFailure: onLoadFailure('pet'),
    });
    pet = petWin;

    // ---- §9.3: ModeStore before BrainService; its `restored` broadcast lands after the windows exist.
    const modes = new ModeStore(database);
    modeStore = modes;
    /** §2.8: pet, bubble, chat — in that order. §12.2: one `mode` record per change. */
    const broadcastMode = (mode: PersonaModeIpc, reason: 'command' | 'restored' | 'tray'): void => {
      sendToPet(petWin, Channels.modeChanged, { mode, reason });
      sendTo(bubbleWin?.peek() ?? null, Channels.modeChanged, { mode, reason });
      sendTo(chatWin?.peek() ?? null, Channels.modeChanged, { mode, reason });
      trace.write('mode', { mode, reason });
    };
    modes.onChange((mode, reason) => {
      broadcastMode(mode, reason);
      sim?.dispatch({ type: 'MODE', mode });
    });

    // ---- §11.2 / §11.3: the bubble — eager at first need, destroyed after the grace, recreated on demand.
    const bubbleHooks: BubbleWindowHooks = {
      onLoadFailure: onLoadFailure('bubble'),
      // CX-6: interrupt the turn and reset the bubble state before the page is reloaded.
      onCrash: () => brain?.bubbleCrashed(),
      onReloaded: () => {
        brain?.reposition(true);
        visibility.resend();
      },
      // A second death or a failed reload: a fresh window. Deferred off the dying webContents' event.
      onUnrecoverable: () => setImmediate(() => {
        if (!brain) return; // quitting
        bubbles.destroy();
        showBubble(bubbleVis.wanted);
      }),
    };
    const bubbles = new LazyWindow<BrowserWindow>(() => createBubbleWindow(bubbleHooks), {
      onCreated: (w) => {
        // §11.3: a recreated bubble replays what it missed on did-finish-load — bubble:place (via
        // reposition(true)), shell:visibility, mode:changed, the latest sim:state — then reconciles.
        w.webContents.once('did-finish-load', () => {
          if (bubbles.peek() !== w) return;
          brain?.reposition(true);
          sendTo(w, Channels.shellVisibility, visibility.verdict);
          sendTo(w, Channels.modeChanged, { mode: modes.get(), reason: 'restored' });
          if (sim) sendTo(w, Channels.simState, sim.snapshot());
          bubbleVis.apply();
        });
      },
    });
    bubbleWin = bubbles;
    // The first need is BrainService.start()'s first-message check (§6.6), so the create happens
    // here — inside FIRST_MESSAGE_BUDGET_MS. After the first grace it is lazy (§11.2's table).
    bubbles.get();
    bubbleVis.apply();

    // ---- §11.2: chat, warm-lazy (pre-created once after stage:ready, destroyed on close).
    const chats = new LazyWindow<BrowserWindow>(() => createChatWindow({
      onLoadFailure: onLoadFailure('chat'),
      // G2-6: reloaded once by the window itself; a second death has no recovery.
      onUnrecoverable: () => fatal(`聊天窗口崩溃了，重启后也没能恢复。请重新打开${personaName(bundle)}。`),
    }), {
      onCreated: (w) => {
        // §3.11: chat window show/hide -> CHAT_OPEN. `hide` catches every close path (Escape,
        // blur light-dismiss, chat:close, VisibilityState) — the same reason brain-service.ts
        // listens to these two events for the band's placement.
        w.on('show', () => sim?.dispatch({ type: 'CHAT_OPEN', on: true }));
        w.on('hide', () => {
          sim?.dispatch({ type: 'CHAT_OPEN', on: false });
          // §11.2 "destroyed on close". Deferred off the event so closeChat's own callers finish.
          setImmediate(() => {
            if (chats.peek() === w && !w.isDestroyed() && !w.isVisible()) chats.destroy();
          });
        });
      },
    });
    chatWin = chats;

    // ---- §11.2: key, lazy (created on the first openKeyWindow(reason), destroyed on close).
    // CX-7: a key renderer that died is rebuilt on the next open; the tray item always recovers.
    let keyCrashed = false;
    const keyHooks = {
      onLoadFailure: onLoadFailure('key'),
      onCrash: () => {
        keyCrashed = true;
      },
    };
    const keys = new LazyWindow<BrowserWindow>(() => createKeyWindow(keyHooks), {
      // §6.5: `key:status` is pushed on every open; a fresh window also needs its first one.
      onCreated: (w) => w.once('ready-to-show', () => brain?.refreshKeyStatus()),
    });
    keyWin = keys;
    const showKeyWindow = (reason: KeyWindowReason): void => {
      if (keyCrashed) {
        keyCrashed = false;
        keys.destroy();
      }
      openKeyWindow(keys.get(), reason);
      brain?.refreshKeyStatus();
    };
    // CX-3: every show of the focusable key window is gated on the shell verdict.
    const keyGate = createKeyRequest({
      visibility: { hidden: () => visibility.verdict.hidden, get: visibility.get },
      show: showKeyWindow,
    });
    keyRequest = keyGate;

    // ---- memory
    const keyStore = new KeyStore();
    const summary = new RunningSummary(database);
    const factStore = new FactStore(database);
    const store = new HistoryStore({
      db: database,
      summary,
      factStore,
      // §4.3: a throwing `summarize` is logged and the turn proceeds untrimmed.
      summarize: async (oldSummary, dropped) => {
        const client = brain?.currentClient();
        if (!client) throw new Error('[summary] no brain client; skipping this trim');
        return makeSummarizer(client, personaName(bundle))(oldSummary, dropped);
      },
    });
    history = store;
    const ledger = new ProactiveLogStore(database); // CONTRACT GAP 3
    const facts = new FactExtractor({
      // Rebuilt on every key change, so the extractor reads the client live (CONTRACT GAP 7).
      client: () => brain?.currentClient() ?? null,
      store: factStore,
      history: store,
      db: database,
    });
    extractor = facts;

    // ---- §10 / §3.11: the sensor, the sim, the motor
    const activity = createActivitySensor({
      cursor: () => screen.getCursorScreenPoint(),
      scaleFactor: () => screen.getDisplayMatching(petWin.getBounds()).scaleFactor,
      // R3-36 / contract Amendment A3-2: inside WIGGLE_NEAR_DIP of this point the sensor samples the
      // cursor at 10 Hz and runs the D11 wiggle predicate; outside it, 2 Hz and nothing else. Same
      // coordinate space as `cursor` above, which is what the sensor's DIP conversion assumes.
      petCentre: () => {
        if (petWin.isDestroyed()) return null;
        const b = petWin.getBounds();
        return { x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 };
      },
    });
    sensor = activity;
    const simService = new SimService({
      pet: petWin,
      bubble: () => bubbles.peek(), // CONTRACT GAP 8
      db: database,
      sensor: activity,
      petBounds: () => petWin.getBounds(),
      workArea: () => screen.getDisplayMatching(petWin.getBounds()).workArea,
      trace, // CONTRACT GAP 8
    });
    sim = simService;
    activity.onInput(() => simService.dispatch({ type: 'USER_INPUT' }));           // immediately (R3-1)
    activity.onDndChanged((on) => simService.dispatch({ type: 'DND', on }));        // §10.5 (the §3.11 row's NotificationState.onChange)
    activity.onBattery((b) => simService.dispatch({ type: 'BATTERY', charging: b.charging, level: b.level }));

    const motor = new WindowMotionController({
      pet: petWin,
      cursor: () => screen.getCursorScreenPoint(),
      workAreas: () => screen.getAllDisplays().map((d) => d.workArea),
      workArea: () => screen.getDisplayMatching(petWin.getBounds()).workArea,
      setPosition: (x, y) => { if (!petWin.isDestroyed()) petWin.setPosition(x, y, false); },
      setClickThrough: (ignore) => setClickThrough(petWin, ignore),
      suspendHoverSwitching: (suspend) => {
        petClickThrough.suspended = suspend;
        if (!suspend) petClickThrough.apply();
      },
      send: (channel, payload) => {
        // §7.8: the renderer interpolates from these; §12.2 motion/landing records (CONTRACT GAP 9).
        if (channel === 'sim:windowMotion') {
          const m = payload as { generation: number; phase: string; vx: number; vy: number; lagX: number; lagY: number };
          sendToPet(petWin, Channels.simWindowMotion, m as never);
          trace.write('motion', { phase: m.phase, generation: m.generation, vx: m.vx, vy: m.vy, lagX: m.lagX, lagY: m.lagY });
        } else {
          const l = payload as { generation: number; impulse: number };
          sendToPet(petWin, Channels.simLanding, l as never);
          trace.write('landing', { generation: l.generation, impulse: l.impulse });
        }
      },
      persist: () => savePetPosition(petWin),
    });
    motion = motor;

    // ---- BrainService (Task 14's Phase 3 deps; windows as getters per §11.2 — CONTRACT GAP 10)
    const service = new BrainService({
      pet: petWin,
      bubble: () => bubbles.peek(),
      chat: () => chats.peek(),
      key: () => keys.peek(),
      db: database,
      store,
      keyStore,
      bundle,
      sim: simService,
      modeStore: modes,
      motion: motor,
      factStore,
      extractor: facts,
      setBubbleVisible: showBubble,
      openKeyWindow: (reason) => keyGate.request(reason),
    });
    brain = service;

    // ---- §3.10.3: the proactive controller (deps — CONTRACT GAP 1)
    const controller = new ProactiveController({
      sim: simService,
      sensor: activity,
      brain: () => brain,
      ledger,
      db: database,
      bundle,
      bubble: () => bubbles.peek(),
      chat: () => chats.peek(),
      trace,
    });
    proactive = controller;

    // ---- §11.3: the bubble's grace/destroy ordering (CONTRACT GAP 2)
    bubbleLifecycle = new BubbleLifecycle({
      bubble: bubbles,   // Task 7's BubbleLifecycleDeps key is `bubble`, and it is a class, not a factory
      speechLeaseActive: () => brain?.speechLeaseActive() ?? false,
      retireSpeech: () => brain?.retireSpeech() ?? Promise.resolve(),
    });

    // start order: sim (kv restore, 2 Hz tick, proactive recovery) -> brain (subscribes to ModeStore).
    activity.start();
    simService.start();
    service.start();
    // §9.3: `set(get(), 'restored')` is a no-op set and does NOT notify (§9.3's own rule), so the
    // restored broadcast is issued directly (Concern 2). The set() call is kept as the contract states it.
    modes.set(modes.get(), 'restored');
    broadcastMode(modes.get(), 'restored');

    cursorPolling = startCursorPolling(petWin);
    foreground = startForegroundWatch(petWin, (hide) => {
      visibility.set('fullscreen', hide);
      visibility.apply();
      simService.dispatch({ type: 'FULLSCREEN', on: hide });
    });

    // ---- §3.11: powerMonitor rows, alongside the Phase 2 visibility flags.
    powerMonitor.on('lock-screen', () => {
      console.log('[power] lock-screen');
      visibility.set('locked', true);
      visibility.apply();
      simService.dispatch({ type: 'LOCKED' });
    });
    powerMonitor.on('suspend', () => {
      console.log('[power] suspend');
      visibility.set('suspended', true);
      visibility.apply();
      simService.dispatch({ type: 'SUSPEND' });
    });
    powerMonitor.on('unlock-screen', () => {
      console.log('[power] unlock-screen');
      visibility.set('locked', false);
      visibility.apply();
      foreground?.recheck();
      simService.dispatch({ type: 'UNLOCKED' });
    });
    powerMonitor.on('resume', () => {
      console.log('[power] resume');
      visibility.set('suspended', false);
      visibility.apply();
      foreground?.recheck();
      simService.dispatch({ type: 'RESUME' });
    });
    // §3.11: 'on-ac' / 'on-battery' + the sensor's last level (§10.4 ActivitySample.battery).
    powerMonitor.on('on-ac', () => simService.dispatch({ type: 'BATTERY', charging: true, level: activity.sample.battery?.level ?? null }));
    powerMonitor.on('on-battery', () => simService.dispatch({ type: 'BATTERY', charging: false, level: activity.sample.battery?.level ?? null }));

    // ---- pet renderer -> main
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.avatarHover, ({ inside }) => {
      petClickThrough.hoverInside = inside;
      petClickThrough.apply();
    });
    // §5.9: the second, independent click-through reason. ORed with avatar:hover above.
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.arbPassthrough, ({ faded }) => {
      petClickThrough.faded = faded;
      petClickThrough.apply();
    });
    // §7.7 / §2.9: avatar:drag / avatar:dragEnd have no handler; the motor owns the window position.
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.arbGrab, ({ pressId, modelX, modelY, screenX, screenY }) => {
      motor.grab({ pressId, modelX, modelY, screenX, screenY });
    });
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.arbRelease, ({ pressId, wasTap }) => {
      motor.release({ pressId, wasTap });
    });
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.arbTouch, ({ part, alpha, burst, annoyed }) => {
      simService.dispatch({ type: 'TOUCH', part, annoyed });
      trace.write('touch', { part, alpha, burst, annoyed });
    });
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.arbTrace, (p) => trace.writeRenderer(p)); // CONTRACT GAP 4
    // C-12: a single tap stays a reaction; §2.9 keeps this handler as-is.
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.avatarTap, ({ hitArea }) => console.log('[pet] tap', hitArea));
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.stageReady, (info) => {
      console.log('[pet] stage ready', info);
      // The renderer installs its listeners after the Live2D model loads; stage:ready is the sync
      // point (also a reload): the verdict, the cursor, the sim snapshot (§3.11) and the mode.
      visibility.resend();
      cursorPolling?.recheck();
      sendToPet(petWin, Channels.simState, simService.snapshot());
      sendToPet(petWin, Channels.modeChanged, { mode: modes.get(), reason: 'restored' });
      // §11.2: pre-create the chat once, so the first user-visible open is warm (C8). Through
      // createChatWindow()'s show:false; never show()/focus() here (D10).
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (brain && !chats.alive) chats.get();
      }, CHAT_PRECREATE_DELAY_MS);   // Task 7's constant (§5.13: one home)
    });
    onFromPet(petWin, Channels.stageError, ({ message }) => console.error('[pet] stage error', message));

    // I-7 / FW-4: the ONE way into the chat.
    const requestChat = (source: ChatRequestSource, focusComposer: boolean): void => {
      const decision = decideChatRequest({ hidden: visibility.verdict.hidden, get: visibility.get });
      console.log('[chat] request source=%s decision=%s', source, decision);
      if (decision === 'refuse') {
        console.log('[chat] refused: hidden reason=%s', visibility.verdict.reason);
        return;
      }
      if (decision === 'reveal') {
        // The user asked for her back (tray toggle undone), as a second launch does (RESIDUAL-2).
        visibility.set('user', false);
        visibility.apply();
        simService.dispatch({ type: 'USER_HIDDEN', on: false });
      }
      if (source === 'key') keys.peek()?.hide();
      openChat(chats.get(), petWin, focusComposer);
    };
    chatRequest.bind(requestChat);

    // §2.7 / §11.2: three windows may send chat:open; the getter form looks them up at event time.
    onFromAny(
      () => [petWin, bubbles.peek(), keys.peek()].filter((w): w is BrowserWindow => w !== null),
      Channels.chatOpen,
      ({ source, focusComposer }) => requestChat(source, focusComposer),
    );

    // ---- §3.5 / §3.10.4 / §9.5 / §5.9 / §5.12 / §8.9: the tray
    const kvBool = (key: string): boolean => getKv(database, key) === '1';
    const mutedRaw = getKv(database, KV_PROACTIVE_MUTED);
    let dndUntilWall: number | null = mutedRaw === null || mutedRaw === '' ? null : Number(mutedRaw);
    let workMode = kvBool(KV_WORK_MODE);
    let sfxMuted = kvBool(KV_SFX_MUTED);
    // R3-35 / A3-1: seed the broadcast mirror from kv. This runs after `simService.start()` but well
    // before the pet renderer's `stage:ready`, whose handler re-sends `simService.snapshot()` — so a
    // restart with 工作模式 already on never shows the renderer a frame at the default.
    simService.setUiFlags({ workMode, sfxMuted });
    const exportMemory = async (): Promise<void> => {
      const res = await dialog.showSaveDialog({
        title: '导出记忆',
        defaultPath: join(app.getPath('documents'), 'ds-memory.json'),
        filters: [{ name: 'JSON', extensions: ['json'] }],
      });
      if (res.canceled || !res.filePath) return;
      // §8.9: facts + summaries + kv (minus `mode`, minus every `ui_*` key). Never `messages`.
      const kvRows = database.prepare('SELECT key, value FROM kv').all() as { key: string; value: string }[];
      const kv = Object.fromEntries(kvRows.filter((r) => r.key !== 'mode' && !r.key.startsWith('ui_')).map((r) => [r.key, r.value]));
      const out = { exportedAt: Date.now(), facts: factStore.list(), summary: summary.getSync(), kv };
      writeFileSync(res.filePath, JSON.stringify(out, null, 2), 'utf8');
      console.log('[memory] exported to %s', res.filePath);
    };
    const wipeMemory = async (): Promise<void> => {
      const { response } = await dialog.showMessageBox({
        type: 'warning',
        buttons: ['清空', '取消'],
        defaultId: 1,
        cancelId: 1,
        message: '清空全部记忆？',
        detail: `将清空 %APPDATA%\\ds\\ds.sqlite 里的事实与摘要（聊天记录保留）。此操作无法撤销。`,
      });
      if (response !== 0) return;
      const n = factStore.wipe();
      summary.setSync('');
      setKv(database, KV_TURNS_SINCE_EXTRACT, '0');
      console.log('[memory] wiped %d facts', n);
    };
    tray = createTray({
      toggleVisible: () => {
        const on = !visibility.get('user');
        visibility.set('user', on);
        visibility.apply();
        simService.dispatch({ type: 'USER_HIDDEN', on });
      },
      toggleDebug: () => {
        console.log('[tray] debug:toggle');
        sendToPet(petWin, Channels.debugToggle, {});
      },
      openChat: () => requestChat('tray', true),
      openKey: () => keyGate.request('user'),
      quit: () => app.quit(),
      setLiveliness: (preset: LivelinessPreset) => {
        const value = LIVELINESS_PRESETS[preset];
        setKv(database, KV_LIVELINESS, String(value));
        simService.dispatch({ type: 'LIVELINESS', value });
      },
      getLiveliness: () => simService.liveliness,
      setDnd: (untilWall) => {
        dndUntilWall = untilWall;
        simService.dispatch({ type: 'PROACTIVE_MUTE', untilWall });
      },
      getDnd: () => dndUntilWall,
      setMode: (mode) => modes.set(mode, 'tray'),
      getMode: () => modes.get(),
      // R3-35 / contract Amendment A3-1: kv stays the durable home and this file stays the writer,
      // and `SimService.setUiFlags` mirrors the pair onto every `sim:state` so the pet renderer can
      // act on it — §5.9's fade (Task 8's machine) and §5.12's mute (Task 5's SfxPlayer), applied by
      // Task 13's `stage/ui-flags.ts`. No channel was added; the two booleans are §2.4 fields.
      setWorkMode: (on) => {
        workMode = on;
        setKv(database, KV_WORK_MODE, on ? '1' : '0');
        simService.setUiFlags({ workMode, sfxMuted });
      },
      getWorkMode: () => workMode,
      setMuted: (on) => {
        sfxMuted = on;
        setKv(database, KV_SFX_MUTED, on ? '1' : '0');
        simService.setUiFlags({ workMode, sfxMuted });
      },
      getMuted: () => sfxMuted,
      exportMemory: () => { void exportMemory().catch((err) => console.error('[memory] export failed', err)); },
      wipeMemory: () => { void wipeMemory().catch((err) => console.error('[memory] wipe failed', err)); },
    });

    if (!globalShortcut.register('Control+Shift+Space', () => requestChat('hotkey', true))) {
      console.error('[hotkey] Ctrl+Shift+Space is already taken by another app');
    }

    // Registered here, not at module scope: `electron.screen` throws before `ready` (Phase 1 note).
    screen.on('display-removed', onDisplaysChanged);
    screen.on('display-metrics-changed', onDisplaysChanged);

    // §11.4 item 1: DS_MEASURE=1 writes the process tree's PIDs for scripts/measure-memory.ps1.
    if (process.env.DS_MEASURE === '1') {
      const writePids = (): void => {
        const pids = app.getAppMetrics().map((m) => m.pid);
        writeFileSync(join(app.getPath('temp'), 'ds-pids.json'), JSON.stringify({ pids, writtenAt: Date.now() }), 'utf8');
      };
      writePids();
      pidsTimer = setInterval(writePids, PIDS_REFRESH_MS);
    }

    // First run with no key at all: the key window is the only door (C-10).
    if (!useFakeBrain(app.isPackaged, process.env) && keyStore.get() === null) {
      keyGate.request('first-run');
    }
  }).catch((err: unknown) => {
    console.error('[main] startup failed', err);
    app.quit();
  });

  app.on('window-all-closed', () => {
    /* keep running in the tray */
  });

  // Phase 1's block, kept in its Phase 1 position. §7.7: the motor rebases the live episode
  // BEFORE the bubble is re-placed, so the band follows the clamped position, not the stale one.
  const onDisplaysChanged = (): void => {
    if (pet && reconcileDisplays(pet)) console.log('[pet] moved back onto a live display');
    motion?.rebase();
    brain?.reposition();
  };

  // I-9 / §3.11: `before-quit` is prevented, the composed drain awaited — brain → proactive →
  // sim → extractor — and only then the db closed and `app.quit()` called again. Every new await
  // sits between `brain.dispose()` and `db.close()`.
  const beforeQuit = createBeforeQuit({
    teardownSync: () => {
      screen.removeListener('display-removed', onDisplaysChanged);
      screen.removeListener('display-metrics-changed', onDisplaysChanged);
      // §11.2: markQuitting keeps its meaning for the pet and bubble only.
      markQuitting();
      // §7.7: the motor persists the settled position; the Phase 2 safety net stays after it.
      motion?.dispose();
      motion = null;
      if (pet) savePetPosition(pet);
      globalShortcut.unregisterAll();
      cursorPolling?.stop();
      foreground?.stop();
      sensor?.stop();
      bubbleLifecycle?.dispose();
      bubbleLifecycle = null;
      if (pidsTimer) clearInterval(pidsTimer);
      pidsTimer = null;
      tray?.destroy();
      tray = null;
    },
    drain: composeDrain([
      { name: 'brain', dispose: () => { const s = brain; brain = null; return s ? s.dispose() : Promise.resolve(); } },
      { name: 'proactive', dispose: () => { const p = proactive; proactive = null; return p ? p.dispose() : Promise.resolve(); } },
      { name: 'sim', dispose: () => { const s = sim; sim = null; return s ? s.dispose() : Promise.resolve(); } },
      { name: 'extractor', dispose: () => { const e = extractor; extractor = null; return e ? e.dispose() : Promise.resolve(); } },
    ]),
    teardownAfterDrain: () => {
      for (const lazy of [bubbleWin, chatWin, keyWin]) lazy?.destroy();
      bubbleWin = null;
      chatWin = null;
      keyWin = null;
      trace.close();
    },
    closeDb: () => {
      // G2-2: fence the store first — a summariser the drain timed out on must find `closed`.
      history?.close();
      history = null;
      db?.close();
      db = null;
    },
    quit: () => app.quit(),
    // §3.11: the parameter form. The value is re-derived from Step 11's measurement.
    timeoutMs: DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS,
  });
  app.on('before-quit', beforeQuit.handler);
}
```

Notes for the engineer, all binding:
- `moveBy` and `holdWindowOpen` are no longer imported; their exports stay in `pet-window.ts` / `key-window.ts` (not this task's files). Do not delete them.
- The `payload as never` casts in `send` exist only because `WindowMotionDeps.send` is typed with the union `WindowMotion | Landing` (§7.1) while `sendToPet` is channel-typed; if Task 10 ships `send` with two overloads instead, delete the casts.
- `activity.sample.battery` is `{charging, level} | null` (§10.4).

Run: `npx vitest run --project desktop src/main/index.test.ts`
Expected PASS line: `Tests  10 passed (10)` (8 as generated + the R3-35 and R3-36 wiring cases).

**Concerns for the controller:**

1. **`DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS` (§3.11 note).** The contract offers "re-derive from the observed p95 (`trace.ts` records it as a `resource` line at quit)" or "make it a parameter". The `resource` record's allow-list in §12.2 is `privateWorkingSetMb, privateCommitMb, cpuPct, processes` — a `drainMs` field would **fail Task 7's allow-list test by existing**, so the measurement route as written is unusable. This plan takes the parameter route (`timeoutMs: DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS` from `index.ts`) plus `[quit]` console lines for the measurement, and Step 11's two numbers are necessarily filled from the run. Rule the measurement channel (console lines, as here) acceptable, or add `drainMs` to the `resource` allow-list by Amendment.
2. **§9.3 contradicts itself.** *"calls `set(get(), 'restored')` after the windows exist (so the `mode:changed` broadcast lands)"* versus *"A no-op set does NOT notify"*. A `set` with the same value cannot notify, so the restored broadcast can never come from that call. This plan issues `broadcastMode(get(), 'restored')` directly and keeps the `set()` call. Rule which line of §9.3 wins (and whether Task 6's `ModeStore.set` should notify on `reason === 'restored'` regardless).
3. **Who starts the 10-s proactive timer.** §3.11: *"owned by `ProactiveController`, started by `SimService.start()`"* — but `SimServiceDeps` (§3.11) has no proactive member and `ProactiveController` (Task 14) exports no `start()`. `SimService` also cannot deliver the reducer's `proactiveEvaluate` effect to `evaluate()` without a dep. This plan wires neither and passes `sim` into the controller's deps so the controller can subscribe/poll; the seam must be named in Task 12 or Task 14.
4. **`SimService.dispose()` is listed twice.** §3.11's API says *"Awaited by `BrainService.dispose()`"*; §3.11's quit block awaits it as a separate step after `proactive.dispose()`. This plan follows the quit block (the "exact order") and requires `SimService.dispose()` to be idempotent if Task 14 also awaits it.
5. **`NotificationState.onChange` vs `ActivitySensor.onDndChanged`.** §3.11's row names `NotificationState.onChange`; §10.5 gives `ActivitySensor.onDndChanged(cb)` a signature and Task 12 skeletons `NotificationState` as a poll wrapper inside the sensor. This plan uses `onDndChanged` (the only one with a signature).
6. **Foreground breakpoint plumbing.** §10.3 adds `onForegroundChanged` to `startForegroundWatch`'s return; §10.5 also puts `onForegroundChanged` on `ActivitySensor`; Task 14 consumes the sensor's. Nothing bridges `foreground.ts` → sensor (the sensor's deps are `cursor/scaleFactor/win32`). This plan passes `sensor` to the controller and bridges nothing; Task 12 must either feed the sensor from `foreground.ts` or the controller must take `foreground` — controller's call.
7. **CLOSED by R3-35 / contract Amendment A3-1 — work mode and 静音 now have a carrier.** The self-review found the tray writing `ui_work_mode` / `ui_sfx_muted` to kv with nothing carrying them to the pet renderer, so bar §0's work-mode fade and §5.12's mute were unreachable end to end. The controller took the cheaper of the two options: **two booleans on `SimSnapshot`** (`uiWorkMode`, `uiSfxMuted`, default `false`), landed in Task 1's single §2 edit — no new channel, so the shared-protocol exception is untouched. This file stays the kv writer and the tray's source of truth and now also calls `simService.setUiFlags({workMode, sfxMuted})` three times: once seeded from kv, and once in each setter. Task 12 overlays the pair onto every snapshot; Task 13's `stage/ui-flags.ts` applies it. One residue: `SimServiceDeps` gained no member for this — `setUiFlags` is a method, so the getter-vs-dep question in Concern 8 does not arise here.
8. **Getter-form windows in `BrainServiceDeps` and `SimServiceDeps`.** §11.2 makes chat and key destroyable and §11.3 makes the bubble destroyable, but `BrainServiceDeps.bubble/chat/key: BrowserWindow` (Phase 2) and `SimServiceDeps.bubble: BrowserWindow` (§3.11) are plain windows, and neither Task 12's nor Task 14's skeleton lists the getter change. `index.ts` is written against getters (`() => BrowserWindow | null`); without them the lazy lifecycle cannot compile. Assign the deps change explicitly (Task 14 for `brain-service.ts`, Task 12 for `sim-service.ts`).
9. **`key-window.ts:52` contains the literal `小春 · API Key`.** The R3-19 acceptance grep over `apps/desktop/src/main` will fail on it; `key-window.ts` is in no §1.5 row, so no Phase 3 task may edit it. Either add a §1.5 row (one-line change to `title: \`${name} · API Key\`` via a `createKeyWindow(hooks, title)` parameter) or exempt the file in the grep.
10. **§3.11's first row** says the TICK `setInterval(500)` is wired "in `main/index.ts`", while §3.11's `SimService.start()` doc and Task 12 put the 2 Hz timer inside `SimService`. This plan does not create a second timer (§3.11's own "only timer" sentence forbids it).
11. **kv `sim_liveliness` writer.** §8.1 lists the owner as "tray → SimService"; Task 12 produces only `sim_snapshot/sim_affection/sim_days_seen` writes. This plan writes `sim_liveliness` from the tray action in `index.ts` before dispatching `LIVELINESS`; if Task 12 also writes it on the event, one of the two should go.

- [ ] **Step 5: Pass the extras through `Live2DStage.create`**

In `packages/stage/src/stage.ts`, add above `export class Live2DStage` (line 40):

```ts
/**
 * §4.10 `extraMotions` → the loader's flat list. The group key (`"Extra"`) is a container in the
 * JSON; the motion is addressed by `name` (§4.10: "`name` is what §4.9 binds against").
 */
function flattenExtraMotions(config: CharacterConfig): ExtraMotionRef[] {
  const groups = config.extraMotions ?? {};
  const out: ExtraMotionRef[] = [];
  for (const entries of Object.values(groups)) {
    for (const { file, name } of entries) out.push({ file, name });
  }
  return out;
}
```
